description_en: Updates the development state information of a data service API
description_zh: 调用UpdateDataServiceApi更新数据服务API开发态的信息
name: UpdateDataServiceApi

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the Data Studio page, click the username in the upper-right corner, and choose Menu > User Information to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The request method of the API. Valid values: 0 (GET), 1 (POST), 2 (PUT), and 3 (DELETE). Wizard and script APIs support GET and POST. Registered APIs support GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE
parameters.help_zh: API的请求方式，可选枚举值包括0（GET）、1（POST）、2（PUT）和3（DELTE）。向导和脚本API支持GET和POST。注册API支持GET、POST、PUT和DELETE
parameters.name: request_method

parameters.help_en: The response data type of the API. Valid values: 0 (JSON) and 1 (XML). Wizard and script APIs support JSON. Registered APIs support JSON and XML
parameters.help_zh: API的返回数据类型，可选枚举值包括0（JSON）和1（XML）。向导和脚本API支持JSON，注册API支持JSON和XML
parameters.name: response_content_type

parameters.help_en: The timeout period, in milliseconds. Valid values: (0, 30000]
parameters.help_zh: 超时时间，单位为毫秒（ms），取值范围为(0, 30000]
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The visibility scope. Valid values: 0 (workspace) and 1 (private)
parameters.help_zh: 可见范围，可选枚举值包括0（工作空间）和1（私有）
parameters.name: visible_range

parameters.help_en: The API protocol. Valid values: 0 (HTTP) and 1 (HTTPS). Multiple values are supported. Separate multiple values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: API协议，可选枚举值包括0（HTTP）和1（HTTPS）。支持多值，多个值之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: protocols

parameters.help_en: The details of the wizard API. For more information, see the JSON string of the wizardDetails field in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 向导API的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html接口wizardDetails字段的JSON String
parameters.name: wizard_details

parameters.help_zh: 脚本API的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html接口scriptDetails字段的JSON String
